_comment: Animation clip → UEC fighter state. Every entry visually verified weapon-free against the library's preview GIFs. `inplace` ids have root motion pre-stripped; where only a root-motion clip exists the baker zeroes the Hips translation itself, so the choice is not a constraint.

_traps.Combat_Stance: id 89 — LOOKS ideal by name, but the character holds a SWORD. Unusable.
_traps.Chest_Pound_Taunt: id 88 — holds sword AND shield. Unusable.
_traps.note: The Fighting group is mixed with armed-combat clips. Never pick by name alone; check the preview.

idle.note: shadowbox loop; body pivots, so baker must lock Hips yaw

jump.note: no inplace variant; strip root translation at bake

launch.note: reads as a genuine anti-air uppercut

victory.note: UNRESOLVED — the obvious pick (Chest_Pound_Taunt) is armed. Candidates to check: Angry_Ground_Stomp 255, or a Dancing-group clip.

alternates._why: Per-character variety without new meshes: give characters different clips for the same state.

baker_requirements: Zero Hips translation X/Z so the game owns position, not the animation.
Lock Hips yaw so the fighter stays side-on to the opponent.
Fixed scale across all frames of all clips, or the character changes size between states.
